criteria.text:
Given a dispatched lane whose ac-checklist.json contains "<unknown>" and "->"
and whose review-verdict.json contains no angle brackets
When the lane returns the line printed by `faff evidence return`
and the dispatcher pipes that line, as received through the return channel, into `faff evidence verify-return`
Then verify-return exits 0 with verdict "agree"
and evidence_persisted carries both files' leaf sha256 values, equal to `faff integrity-digest hash` of each file
and no park is recorded for the unit
criteria.exercised: fixture ISSUE-1/ac-checklist.json containing "<unknown> -> & a" and an angle-bracket-free review-verdict.json; faff evidence return --run-dir .faff/runs/r1 --issue ISSUE-1; line passed through an HTML-entity escape of < > & then piped to faff evidence verify-return; faff integrity-digest hash of each file via stdin
criteria.expected: verify-return exit 0, verdict agree, evidence_persisted ac_sha256/review_verdict_sha256 equal to integrity-digest hash of each file, and no park recorded for the unit
criteria.observed: escaped line identical to original; verify-return exit 0, verdict agree, park_cause null; evidence_persisted ac_sha256 9cbfc3ee...d7fa and review_verdict_sha256 2d4308d3...1a2f, both equal to integrity-digest hash output
criteria.reason: CLI half met (exit 0, agree, digests equal integrity-digest hash, park_cause null); 'no park is recorded for the unit' is an orchestrator outcome: orchestrator clause has no exposed surface in this env (CLI-only container, no dispatcher/wave/ship)

criteria.text:
Given a lane returned an EvidenceReturn for ac-checklist.json and review-verdict.json
When a process appends one byte to ac-checklist.json after the return and before the dispatcher's check
Then verify-return exits 1 with verdict "mismatch"
and park_cause is "evidence-return mismatch — <issue>/ac-checklist.json (returned copy ≠ on-disk copy)"
and only that unit is parked; sibling units in the same wave keep running
criteria.exercised: faff evidence return on ISSUE-1, then printf x >> ISSUE-1/ac-checklist.json, then the held line piped to faff evidence verify-return; sibling ISSUE-3 in same run dir verified with its own untouched return
criteria.expected: exit 1, verdict mismatch, park_cause 'evidence-return mismatch — ISSUE-1/ac-checklist.json (returned copy ≠ on-disk copy)', only that unit parked while siblings keep running
criteria.observed: exit 1; verdict mismatch; ac-checklist result hash-mismatch; park_cause 'evidence-return mismatch — ISSUE-1/ac-checklist.json (returned copy ≠ on-disk copy)'; tampered_paths [ISSUE-1/ac-checklist.json]; sibling ISSUE-3 verdict agree
criteria.reason: CLI half met (exit 1, mismatch, verbatim park_cause, verdict scoped to --issue, sibling still agrees); 'only that unit is parked; sibling units in the same wave keep running' is wave/park behaviour: orchestrator clause has no exposed surface in this env (CLI-only container, no dispatcher/wave/ship)

criteria.text:
Given a lane return that passed verify-return on return
When ac-checklist.json is modified after that check and before the merge locus
Then the pre-merge re-verify exits 1, the unit is parked, and slots.ship is never invoked for it
criteria.exercised: run-ledger.json with evidence_persisted entry from an agreed return; ac-checklist.json modified (one byte appended); faff evidence verify-return --against-ledger --run-dir .faff/runs/r1 --issue ISSUE-1
criteria.expected: pre-merge re-verify exits 1, the unit is parked, slots.ship never invoked
criteria.observed: exit 1; verdict mismatch; ac-checklist result hash-mismatch; park_cause 'evidence-return mismatch — ISSUE-1/ac-checklist.json (returned copy ≠ on-disk copy)'
criteria.reason: CLI half met (re-verify exits 1); 'the unit is parked, and slots.ship is never invoked' is orchestrator behaviour: orchestrator clause has no exposed surface in this env (CLI-only container, no dispatcher/wave/ship)

criteria.text:
Given a lane whose review-verdict.json does not exist on disk
When the lane's EvidenceReturn reports review_verdict as present with a sha256
Then verify-return exits 1 with result "presence-disagreement" for review-verdict.json
and park_cause is "evidence-return mismatch — <issue>/review-verdict.json (presence disagreement)"
criteria.exercised: run dir r2: ISSUE-2/ac-checklist.json present, review-verdict.json absent; stdin {issue:ISSUE-2, ac_checklist:{present:true, sha256:<disk hash>}, review_verdict:{present:true, sha256:'ab'x32}} to faff evidence verify-return --run-dir .faff/runs/r2 --issue ISSUE-2
criteria.expected: exit 1, review-verdict.json result presence-disagreement, park_cause 'evidence-return mismatch — ISSUE-2/review-verdict.json (presence disagreement)'
criteria.observed: exit 1; files[1] {file: review-verdict.json, returned_present true, disk_present false, result presence-disagreement}; park_cause 'evidence-return mismatch — ISSUE-2/review-verdict.json (presence disagreement)'

criteria.text:
Given a member whose return check agreed and whose evidence_persisted entry is in the ledger
and the dispatcher's conversation has since been compacted
When ac-checklist.json is modified before the merge locus
and the dispatcher runs the run-grain verify and `faff evidence verify-return --against-ledger`
Then verify-return exits 1 with result "hash-mismatch", the unit is parked, and slots.ship is never invoked
criteria.exercised: run-ledger.json evidence_persisted [stale ISSUE-1 entry, then agreed ISSUE-1 entry]; ac-checklist.json modified; faff evidence verify-return --against-ledger --run-dir .faff/runs/r1 --issue ISSUE-1 (stdin /dev/null); control: file restored, re-run
criteria.expected: verify-return exits 1 with result hash-mismatch, the unit is parked, slots.ship never invoked
criteria.observed: modified: exit 1, ac-checklist result hash-mismatch (returned_sha256 = last ledger entry's ac_sha256); restored control: exit 0 agree, confirming the last entry is used
criteria.reason: CLI half met (exit 1, hash-mismatch from the ledger claim); the run-grain verify, 'the unit is parked' and 'slots.ship is never invoked' are orchestrator behaviour: orchestrator clause has no exposed surface in this env (CLI-only container, no dispatcher/wave/ship)

criteria.text:
Given a pr-ready member with ac-checklist.json on disk and no evidence_persisted entry in the ledger
When the dispatcher runs `faff evidence verify-return --against-ledger` before the merge locus
Then verify-return exits 1 with result "no-claim", the unit is never merged,
and no integrity_tampered entry is written
criteria.exercised: run dir r2 with ISSUE-2/ac-checklist.json on disk and run-ledger.json whose evidence_persisted has only an ISSUE-9 entry (and, separately, an empty array); faff evidence verify-return --against-ledger --run-dir .faff/runs/r2 --issue ISSUE-2; ledger sha256 before/after
criteria.expected: exit 1 with result no-claim, unit never merged, no integrity_tampered entry written
criteria.observed: exit 1; ac-checklist result no-claim; park_cause 'evidence-return missing — ISSUE-2/ac-checklist.json (no digest returned for a file on disk)'; tampered_paths []; run-ledger.json sha256 unchanged (2f31c045...abe)
criteria.reason: CLI half met (exit 1, no-claim, tampered_paths empty, ledger untouched); 'the unit is never merged' is merge-locus behaviour: orchestrator clause has no exposed surface in this env (CLI-only container, no dispatcher/wave/ship)

criteria.text:
Given an EvidenceReturn whose JSON the return channel has broken
When it is piped into verify-return
Then verify-return exits 1 with verdict "malformed"
and the unit is parked with no integrity_tampered entry
criteria.exercised: faff evidence return line with every '"' replaced by " (and separately truncated to 60 chars) piped to faff evidence verify-return --run-dir .faff/runs/r1 --issue ISSUE-1
criteria.expected: exit 1 with verdict malformed, unit parked with no integrity_tampered entry
criteria.observed: both inputs: exit 1; verdict malformed; park_cause 'evidence-return malformed — ISSUE-1/EvidenceReturn (malformed return)'; tampered_paths []
criteria.reason: CLI half met (exit 1, malformed, tampered_paths empty so nothing to append); 'the unit is parked' is orchestrator behaviour: orchestrator clause has no exposed surface in this env (CLI-only container, no dispatcher/wave/ship)

criteria.text:
Given an EvidenceReturn in the old shape, carrying ac_checklist.body instead of ac_checklist.sha256
When it is piped into verify-return
Then verify-return exits 1 with verdict "malformed" and never hashes the body
criteria.exercised: stdin {issue:ISSUE-1, ac_checklist:{present:true, body:<file text with < > &>}, review_verdict:{present:true, sha256:<correct>}} (and a variant with correct sha256 plus body) to faff evidence verify-return --run-dir .faff/runs/r1 --issue ISSUE-1
criteria.expected: exit 1 with verdict malformed and the body never hashed
criteria.observed: both: exit 1; verdict malformed; files [] (no returned_sha256/disk_sha256 computed); evidence_persisted null

criteria.text: Neither `faff evidence return` nor `faff evidence verify-return` writes any file.
criteria.reason: prose scenario: no machine check and no delegate verifier

criteria.text: A dispatched build whose `ac-checklist.json` contains `<`, `>` and `&` passes obligation 6 with `verify-return` exit 0 when the files are untouched (first scenario).
criteria.exercised: ac-checklist.json containing < > and &; faff evidence return, HTML-escape of the line, piped to faff evidence verify-return with files untouched
criteria.observed: exit 0; verdict agree; both files result match

criteria.text: `faff evidence return --run-dir <dir> --issue <id>` prints one JSON line matching the EvidenceReturn record, with lowercase 64-hex `sha256` for present files and `null` for absent ones, and exits 0.
criteria.exercised: faff evidence return --run-dir .faff/runs/r1 --issue ISSUE-1 (both present) and --run-dir .faff/runs/r2 --issue ISSUE-2 (review-verdict.json absent)
criteria.expected: one JSON line with keys issue, ac_checklist, review_verdict; lowercase 64-hex sha256 for present files, null for absent; exit 0
criteria.observed: exit 0 both; r1: ac_checklist {present:true, sha256:9cbfc3ee...d7fa (64 lowercase hex)}; r2: review_verdict {present:false, sha256:null}

delegated.text: No obligation 6 prose (l4.md, both executors, graft) asks any agent to compute, compare or paste a sha256 or a file body by hand.
`faff evidence return` exits 2 with nothing on stdout when an evidence file is a symlink, when `--run-dir` is outside `.faff/runs/`, or when `--issue` fails the issue-id rule.
`faff evidence verify-return` prints a ReturnVerdict with `files` in the order `ac-checklist.json`, `review-verdict.json`, and `issue` equal to `--issue`.
`verify-return` exit codes are 0 for `agree`, 1 for `mismatch` and `malformed`, 2 for usage, path rejection, TTY stdin, or hasher unavailable (nothing on stdout for 2).
`evidence_persisted` in the verdict validates against the `evidence_persisted` item schema in `run-ledger.schema.json` and is `null` when no file matched.
Each park cause in the section 3 cause table is produced verbatim by its condition.
`TerminalToken{issue,outcome,pr}` text is unchanged in graft and both executors; EvidenceReturn is still described as a sibling field.
`docs/guide/cli.md` has one row each for `evidence return` and `evidence verify-return`, and `evidence.js` `USAGE` lists both.

`l4.md` obligation 6 describes the digest-only EvidenceReturn, the `verify-return` call, the exit-code branch (0 append, 1 unit park with `integrity_tampered`, 2 unit park without), and no longer tells the dispatcher to rewrite the evidence files.

`l4.md` obligation 7 runs obligation 5's run-grain verify and then `verify-return --against-ledger` before asserting the floor, parks on non-zero, and says "dispatcher-verified" where it said "dispatcher-persisted".
No obligation 6 or 7 prose tells the dispatcher to keep an EvidenceReturn in conversation context past the first check.
`verify-return --against-ledger` reads the last `evidence_persisted` entry for `--issue`; with no entry and a file on disk it gives `no-claim`; with a missing or unparseable ledger it exits 2.

A `malformed` verdict parks the unit without an `integrity_tampered` entry; a `mismatch` verdict appends each `tampered_paths` string to `integrity_tampered` (none for a `no-claim`-only mismatch), and the result validates against `run-ledger.schema.json`.

FAFF-517 carries a comment naming the content-carrying return it inherits (OUT OF SCOPE, first item), and keeps its tracker relation to FAFF-1397, so its prep sees the obligation from the link as well as the text.
Graft line 884 tells a dispatched lane to return the `faff evidence return` line verbatim, or `EvidenceReturn: null` on a non-zero exit.
The parallel executor (lines 99, 103) and sequential executor (lines 40, 42) placement prose refer to `faff evidence verify-return` and do not restate its rules.
ADR-0077 carries the "Return by digest (FAFF-1397 amendment)" Consequences bullet; its Decision text is unchanged.
Neither verb creates, modifies or deletes any file (checked by snapshotting the run dir before and after in a test).
No decision-kernel call site (`next`, `eligible`, `claim-verdict`, `park-verdict`, `run-start`, `run-outward`, `run-done`, `queue-state`, `project-next`) changes in the diff.
The PR body records the two exposure-audit greps from section 4 and their results after the edit.
stdin `null` with both files absent gives `agree`, `evidence_persisted: null`; stdin `null` with a file present gives `no-claim` and no `integrity_tampered` entry.
A return carrying `body`, an uppercase or short hex, `present:false` with a non-null `sha256`, an extra key, or an `issue` different from `--issue` each give `malformed`.
A symlink at an evidence path gives `not-regular-file` in `verify-return`.

A new `test/evidence-return.test.mjs` (node:test, `runCli` helper, fixture pattern from `test/evidence-write.test.mjs`) covers every DONE item above that names CLI behaviour, including a round trip where the EvidenceReturn line is passed through an HTML-entity escape of `<`, `>`, `&` before `verify-return` and still agrees.
`faff evidence --selftest` passes and covers one agree and one mismatch case for the new verbs.
`faff validate-adapters` reports no new FAIL; `faff-graft/SKILL.md` stays at or under 893 lines, and `SKILL_LINE_BASELINE["faff-graft"]` is lowered to the new line count if it shrank.
New prose in the edited Markdown files uses Canadian spelling and no em dashes outside the quoted park-cause strings.
